question: Which museum is closest along the path to Arts by the Bay Gallery, Havre de Grace, MD from Leon and Ethel Yeiser Rose Garden, Annville, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.51439 40.331543)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.08988 39.550044)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.51439 40.331543)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.51439 40.331543)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Leon and Ethel Yeiser Rose Garden, Annville, PA

poi.poi_name: Leon and Ethel Yeiser Rose Garden

[3].display_name: Arts by the Bay Gallery, Havre de Grace, MD
